description: Source code for a Git checkout worker process, handling parallel checkout items, packet communication, and command-line options.

methods.name: packet_to_pc_item
methods.description: Converts a packet buffer into a parallel checkout item, parsing fixed portions and encoding.

methods.name: report_result
methods.description: Sends the result of a checkout item over the packet stream.

methods.name: release_pc_item_data
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for a checkout item.

methods.name: worker_loop
methods.description: Main loop for processing incoming packets, converting to items, executing checkout, and reporting results.

methods.name: cmd_checkout__worker
methods.description: Main command function to initialize checkout state, parse options, and run the worker loop.
